Wind Tunnel Garage

Design your own racing car, test it in a virtual wind tunnel, then race it down a runway.

Step 1 of 3Design and paint

Your job is to make a car that looks brilliant and slips through the air. You can change colours and shape. Nothing you do here can break the car.

  1. Paint it. Tap a part of the car, or pick a panel from the list. Then choose a colour.
  2. Reshape it. Open the Shape tab and move the sliders to change the body.
  3. Test it. Happy with your car? Press the green Finish and test button.
Step 2 of 3Wind tunnel

Air is blowing past your car from the left. Each stream shows what the air is doing. Turn the car by dragging it.

  • Clear air: misses the car
  • Brushes the car
  • Hits the car and slows down

Step 3 of 3Drag race

Does your design really go faster? Race it down the runway against the standard design of the same car. The standard car is the see-through box in the next lane.

  1. Start. Press Start race and wait for the lights to turn green.
  2. Push. Hold GO (or the space bar) to use the motor. Let go and the car coasts.
  3. Steer gently. Use the arrows. Turning wastes speed, so a straight line is fastest. Stay on the tarmac.

Watch the speedo in the corner. The yellow mark is your design's predicted top speed. The faster you go, the harder the air pushes back, and the numbers under the race show it. A car with less drag keeps speeding up for longer.

Before you start

How it works

1

Design

Pick a car, paint every panel and reshape its body.

2

Test

Press Finish and test. Watch the air stream past your car in the wind tunnel.

3

Race

Take your car to the runway. Hold the throttle and see if your design beats the standard car. Then tweak it and go again.

What you will learn

Drag
Air pushing back on the car. Like putting your hand out of a car window.
Downforce
Air pushing the car down. A wing works like an upside-down aeroplane wing.
Top speed
The fastest the car can go with the same engine. A slippery shape goes faster.
Balance
Front and rear grip need to match, or the car will slide.
